summary: argo-cd D53 gains a dated amendment (14308f1): images from registry:5000 are pinned to a per-build tag, never a digest; matrix builds get one and the pin stage writes it wherever a pin list exists (today keycloak's); Argo CD's relay pin is written by relay builds, leaving argocd-prd out of sync for the operator (D3). No D53 sentence changed; done-record committed.
